parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Inventory Management System (PET WF11)

**🎯 Purpose:** Comprehensive inventory management with automated stock monitoring, reorder alerts, and manual update capabilities

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Automated Monitoring:**
• **Daily Stock Checks:** Runs on configurable schedule ({{INVENTORY_CHECK_CRON}})
• **Multi-Level Alerts:** Critical, reorder, and expiry notifications
• **Smart Recommendations:** Calculates optimal reorder quantities
• **Cost Estimation:** Provides reorder cost projections
• **Priority Classification:** Identifies urgent vs. standard needs

**Alert System:**
• **Email Reports:** Detailed HTML reports with item breakdowns
• **SMS Notifications:** Urgent alerts for critical stock levels
• **Multi-Channel Delivery:** Email + SMS for critical items
• **Supplier Information:** Includes supplier details for quick ordering
• **Category Analysis:** Groups items by category for better management

**Manual Updates:**
• **Webhook Integration:** API endpoint for inventory updates
• **Transaction Logging:** Complete audit trail of all changes
• **Batch Management:** Tracks batch numbers and expiry dates
• **Update Types:** Supports manual, received, sold, adjusted updates
• **Real-time Processing:** Immediate inventory updates

**⚡ Workflow Process:**

**Automated Monitoring Flow:**
1. **Scheduled Trigger:** Daily inventory check at configured time
2. **Data Retrieval:** Reads complete inventory from Google Sheets
3. **Stock Analysis:** Evaluates current vs. reorder/critical levels
4. **Expiry Checking:** Identifies items expiring within 30 days
5. **Alert Generation:** Creates detailed HTML email reports
6. **Multi-Channel Alerts:** Sends email + SMS for critical items
7. **Activity Logging:** Records all alert activities

**Manual Update Flow:**
1. **Webhook Trigger:** Receives inventory update requests
2. **Data Validation:** Validates required fields and formats
3. **Inventory Update:** Updates stock levels in Google Sheets
4. **Transaction Logging:** Records change details and audit trail
5. **Response Delivery:** Confirms successful update

**📊 Alert Categories:**
• **CRITICAL:** Items at or below critical level (immediate action)
• **REORDER:** Items at reorder point (schedule orders)
• **EXPIRING:** Items expiring within 30 days (use or dispose)

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Main Inventory: {{INVENTORY_SHEET_ID}}
• Alert Logging: {{INVENTORY_LOG_SHEET_ID}}
• Transaction History: {{INVENTORY_TRANSACTIONS_SHEET_NAME}}
• Email System: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}
• SMS Alerts: {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}}
• Webhook API: {{INVENTORY_UPDATE_WEBHOOK_PATH}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Check Schedule: {{INVENTORY_CHECK_CRON}}
• Inventory Manager: {{INVENTORY_MANAGER_EMAIL}} / {{INVENTORY_MANAGER_PHONE}}
• Admin Notifications: {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
